name: Pullman Bandung Grand Central
short_description: A 5-star, 279-room Pullman opposite the Gedung Sate landmark in central Bandung, with a verified ALL Rating of 4.7/5 (1,263 reviews).
ai_summary: Pullman Bandung Grand Central (Accor code 9109) is a 5-star, 279-room Pullman hotel at Jl Diponegoro No 27, Citarum, Bandung Wetan, positioned as both a staycation destination for weekenders escaping Jakarta and a business hotel for the West Java capital. The hotel offers 2 ballrooms, 19 function rooms, and lifestyle facilities including a kids' club, blending contemporary design with old-world Dutch-influenced architectural touches. Its location near Gedung Sate, Gasibu, and the Geology Museum places it in Bandung's government and cultural district, roughly 15 minutes from the Pasteur toll exit and 17 minutes from Husein Sastranegara Airport. On the Accor ALL platform, the hotel holds a verified rating of 4.7/5 from 1,263 reviews. For ALL elite members, standard Pullman benefits apply: welcome drink for Silver and above, room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond subject to availability, Executive Lounge access for eligible bookings, and early check-in and late check-out for Diamond.
